quote: Sirius's aggregate liability under this Agreement is capped at three (3) months of fees paid. This cap applies to all claims, including those arising from data breach or loss.
policy_quote: Vendor liability cap must be at least 12 months of fees paid. Violation: cap below 12 months, or cap excludes data breach scenarios.
reason: Three months is below the 12-month minimum. The same cap also applies to data-breach claims, so breach liability is limited rather than carved out. Both listed violation conditions are met.
suggested_fix: Raise the cap to at least 12 months of fees and carve data-breach claims out of the cap.
